Name: Swiss Army Knife
Author: emurphy42
Description:
Adds a tool that emulates a keypress when used. This may be helpful if you use a controller.

Default config options are geared for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6523]Mobile Phone by aedenthorn[/url], however ﻿you can repurpose it by changing options and adding a different image in the assets folder.
